newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek inflation seen around 5.0pct in summer - govt.
newsitem.headline: Greek inflation seen around 5.0pct in summer - govt.

text.p: Greek consumer price inflation will fall to around 5.0 percent year-on-year in the summer from 6.6 percent in February, government spokesman Dimitris Reppas told reporters.
"We believe inflation will continue to fall," Reppas said. "We believe that it will be around 5.0 percent in the summer."

He was speaking after a cabinet meeting on economic and foreign affairs. The government will review the performance of the economy in mid-April, Reppas said. --Dina Kyriakidou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
